Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.ArticleDefi.definition: C\text{ is SI}\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\forall a\in [0,1],\quad \forall b\in [0,1],\quad \forall c\in [0,1],\quad \forall v\in [0,1],\quad \left(\left(a \le b \;\land\; b \le c\right) \;\Longrightarrow\; \left(\left(b - a\right)\,C(c,v) + \left(c - b\right)\,C(a,v)\right) \le \left(c - a\right)\,C(b,v)\right).\quad C\text{ is SD}\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\forall a\in [0,1],\quad \forall b\in [0,1],\quad \forall c\in [0,1],\quad \forall v\in [0,1],\quad \left(\left(a \le b \;\land\; b \le c\right) \;\Longrightarrow\; \left(c - a\right)\,C(b,v) \le \left(\left(b - a\right)\,C(c,v) + \left(c - b\right)\,C(a,v)\right)\right)
Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.ArticleDefi.note: This independently parsed statement reuses the native SI/SD inequality and equality classification. It does not certify the printed maximum-principle proof. SI and SD are interpreted via the displayed concavity and convexity chord conditions.

Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.boundaryCop.type:

  (Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.boundaryCopula x hx hx1).chatterjeeXi = x ∧
    (Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.boundaryCopula x hx hx1).spearmanRho = Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.upperRhoAtXi x

Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.lemma8_boun.type:
∀ {g : ↑unitInterval → ℝ},
  Antitone g →
    (∀ (u : ↑unitInterval), g u ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) →
      ∀ (v : ↑unitInterval),
        ∫ (u : ↑unitInterval), g u = ↑v → ↑v * (1 - ↑v) ≤ Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.decreasingFunctional g

Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.lemma8_equa.type:
∀ {g : ↑unitInterval → ℝ},
  Antitone g →
    (∀ (u : ↑unitInterval), g u ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) →
      ∀ (v : ↑unitInterval),
        ∫ (u : ↑unitInterval), g u = ↑v →
          (Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.decreasingFunctional g = ↑v * (1 - ↑v) ↔
            (∀ᵐ (u : ↑unitInterval), g u = ↑v) ∨
              g =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] (Set.Iic v).indicator fun x => 1)

      C = (Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.boundaryCopula x hx hx1).reflect {1})

          Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.sourceBandIntercept b (x 1) < b * (1 - ↑(x 0)) + 1 then
      Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.sourceBandHeight b (x 1)
    else 0

∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (u v : ↑unitInterval),

∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b),

∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (u v : ↑unitInterval),

∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (u v : ↑unitInterval),
  (Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.negativeSourceBand b hb).cdf ![u, v] ≤ ↑u * ↑v

∀ {b d : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d),

        (Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.negativeSourceBand b hb).cdf ![u, v]

∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : Filter α} (b : α → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (a : α), 0 < b a),

∀ (u v : ↑unitInterval),
  Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.plodShuffle.cdf ![u, v] =
    Min.min (Verification.stripCut (1 / 4) 0 ↑u) (Verification.stripCut (1 / 4) 0 ↑v) +
          Min.min (Verification.stripCut (1 / 4) (1 / 4) ↑u) (Verification.stripCut (1 / 4) (1 / 2) ↑v) +
        Min.min (Verification.stripCut (1 / 4) (1 / 2) ↑u) (Verification.stripCut (1 / 4) (1 / 4) ↑v) +

∃ D,
  D.chatterjeeXi = 3 / 10 ∧
    D.spearmanRho = 7 / 10 ∧
      (∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2), C.spearmanRho - C.chatterjeeXi ≤ D.spearmanRho - D.chatterjeeXi) ∧
        ∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2), C.spearmanRho - C.chatterjeeXi = D.spearmanRho - D.chatterjeeXi ↔ C = D

Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.sourceBandD.type:
∀ (b : ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval),
  Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.sourceBandDensityOpen b x =
    if
        b * ↑(x 0) < Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.sourceBandIntercept b (x 1) ∧
          Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.sourceBandIntercept b (x 1) < b * ↑(x 0) + 1 then
      if ↑(x 1) ≤ Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.bandCut b then b / √(2 * b * ↑(x 1))
      else if ↑(x 1) ≤ 1 - Papers.AnsariRockel2026XiRho.bandCut b then Max.max b 1 else b / √(2 * b * (1 - ↑(x 1)))
    else 0
